facts: The original two-storey dwelling at 23 Abercorn Street has stucco over brick, corner quoins, a gable with end parapets, six-over-six sash and a Palladian window over the entrance. The portico was added in 1812.
The stuccoed brick house facing east over a basement has a slate roof. Two pairs of unfluted Doric columns carry the flat entrance porch, below the Palladian window.
